content.short: Salmon Nation is a multi-country bio region that extends from Alaska down to Northern California.
content.description: Salmon Nation Decentralized Alliance seeks to connect changemakers, entreprenuers, and developers in the Salmon Nation bio-region to build solutions to regional and global challenges using decentralized blockchain technology. SANADA - Salmon Nation Decentralized Alliance. A community hub located in the heart of Salmon Nation. Our Purpose SANADA, the Salmon Nation Decentralized Alliance, seeks to connect changemakers, entreprenuers, and developers in the Salmon Nation bio-region to build solutions to regional and global challenges using decentralized blockchain technology.
